narrative: 一面化妆间的墙壁滑开，你已置身于一家夜店。一扇剧院的门变成了一条街道。
地理位置本身完成了剪辑。主体也许并没有被剪辑；是这个世界被剪辑了。
当故事中的空间彼此渗透时使用它：后台如同心灵，城市如同舞台，一间大堂在炮火中重新改写自己。当你只需要把一次拼接藏在一次挥镜里时，这个手法就用错了——那是隐形剪辑（Invisible Cut）。
当A作为一幅画面融化进B时，这个手法也用错了——那是渐变变形（Morphing）。如果摄影机作为一个传送门的戏法穿过一堵墙进入另一个地方，你已经接近穿越镜头（Pass Through）了。
场景转换（Set Transition）是场地在身体周围发生改变。
how: 搭建两个（或更多）完整的空间，让它们能够在一次连续的运动中彼此物理或数字化地替换：滑动的景片、旋转的墙壁、门口处的拼接，或者一次重新改写的数字置景延伸。让布光在空间变化时依然保持动机，或者让灯光变化本身成为这个戏法的一部分。
提示词：set transition around [Subject], the location transforming in camera, walls walking, one space becoming another. 运动脚本：the set around [Subject] transforms into a new location without a hard cut.
when: 用它来从排练走进正式演出，从记忆走进街道，或者从一栋建筑走进另一栋建筑，而不承认存在一次剪辑。当一次直接剪辑或划像转场（Wipe）能够更快地讲清真相时，不要用它。
如果第二个空间里没有任何新东西，再高超的技艺也是空洞的。
vs: 隐形剪辑隐藏的是一次拼接；场地本身可能保持不变。穿越镜头让摄影机穿过一个表面进入另一个空间。
渐变变形是对画面本身的插值处理。场景转换则沿着一条连续的路径重新改写建筑结构，无论是舞台机关还是数字手段。
运动匹配剪辑（Match Motion）可以顺着一个身体的矢量改变世界，而不需要让墙壁“走动”。
examples_film: 《鸟人》（Birdman）让剧院和城市感觉像一个彼此渗透的整体场地。《1917》藏起拼接点，让战壕、废墟和田野呈现为连续的地理空间。
《黑客帝国》（The Matrix）里的那间大堂通过动作和空间连续性重新改写了自身。用这种彼此渗透的建筑，而不是照搬那条摄影机的运动路径。
mistakes: 最常见的误用近亲是让演员发生渐变变形，或者门口处一次明显的剪辑。破绽是：人物融化消失，或者门槛处出现了一次跳动。
解决办法是：让身体保持连续，让墙壁或置景延伸来重新改写空间，隐藏或省略这次拼接，并让布光在变化前后保持匹配。

faq.q: 电影中的“场景转换”是什么？
faq.a: 场景转换是在镜头内改变地点，让建筑结构在主体周围重新改写自己。剪接点的两侧都是同一条连续路径上的地点，而不是被一次硬剪辑分开的两个镜头。

faq.q: 场景转换 vs 隐形剪辑
faq.a: 隐形剪辑隐藏的是一次剪辑；场地可能不会改变。场景转换则让地理关系本身成为那次剪辑：墙壁在走动，房间变成了别的房间。一个隐藏一次拼接；另一个重新改写空间。

faq.q: 什么时候该用场景转换？
faq.a: 当空间应该显得彼此渗透，并且摄影机不应该承认存在一次剪辑时使用。当一次直白的场景转换会更清晰时，不要把它用作一种炫技。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写场景转换的提示词？
faq.a: 说明两个地点以及一个连续的摄影机运动。示例：Set transition around [Subject], walls walking, one space becoming another. 视频版本：the set transforms without a hard cut. 保持身体的稳定。

narrative: A dressing room wall slides and you are in a nightclub. A theatre door is a street.
Geography itself edits. The subject may not have cut; the world did.

Use it when the story's spaces are porous: backstage as mind, city as stage, a lobby that rewrites under fire. It is the wrong tool when you only need to hide a splice in a whip: that is an Invisible Cut.
It is the wrong tool when A melts into B as a picture: that is Morphing. If the camera passes through a wall into another place as a portal gag, you are next to Pass Through.
Set transition is the room changing around the body.
how: Build two (or more) complete spaces that can physically or digitally replace each other on a continuous move: sliding flats, revolving walls, a stitch on a doorway, a digital set extension that rewrites. Keep lighting motivated as the space changes, or let the lights change as part of the trick.

Prompt: set transition around [Subject], the location transforming in camera, walls walking, one space becoming another. Motion brief: the set around [Subject] transforms into a new location without a hard cut.
when: Use it to walk from rehearsal into performance, from memory into a street, from one building into another without admitting an edit. Do not use it if a hard cut or a wipe would tell the truth faster.
Virtuosity with nothing new in the second space is empty.
vs: An Invisible Cut conceals a splice; the set may stay the same. A Pass Through drives the camera through a surface into another space.
Morphing interpolates the image. A set transition rewrites architecture along a continuous path, theatrical or digital.
Match Motion can change worlds on a body vector without the walls walking.
examples_film: Birdman lets theatre and city feel like one porous set. 1917 hides joins so trenches, ruins, and fields play as continuous geography.
The Matrix lobby rewrites a space through action and spatial continuity. Use the porous building, not a copied tracking path.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is Morphing the actor, or a visible cut in a doorway. The tell: the person melts, or there is a pop at the threshold.
The fix: keep the body continuous, let walls or set extension rewrite, hide or omit the splice, match lighting across the change.

faq.q: What is Set Transition in film?
faq.a: A set transition changes location in camera as architecture rewrites around the subject. Both sides of the join are places on one continuous path, not two shots with a hard cut.
An invisible cut hides an edit; the set might not change. A set transition makes geography the edit: walls walk, rooms become other rooms. One conceals a splice; the other rewrites space.

faq.q: When should I use Set Transition?
faq.a: Use it when spaces should feel porous and the camera should not admit a cut. Do not use it as a flex when a straight scene change would be clearer.

faq.q: How do I prompt Set Transition for AI image or video?
faq.a: Name both locations and a continuous camera. Example: Set transition around [Subject], walls walking, one space becoming another. Video: the set transforms without a hard cut. Keep the body stable.
